key_insight: No single entropy captures all properties of quantum systems; complementary measures address distinct information-processing tasks.
engineering_relevance: Choosing an appropriate entropy measure helps characterize limits in quantum communication, cryptography, thermodynamics, and many-body systems.
method: Characterize entropies using natural physical principles.
Survey Rényi and smooth entropies and their interrelations.
Connect information measures to quantum applications.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a structured review, not a new experimental or numerical evaluation, and reports no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: This is not an AI-method paper; applying its framework requires matching entropy definitions and assumptions to the specific quantum task.
